issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

### Issue URL (Ads) [https://news.sportbox.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.sportbox.ru%2F) ### Comment > С началом сентября перестала полностью блокироваться реклама на всех сайтах (где она есть на самом сайте), сразу всплывает перекрывающее всё окно, закрыв его, на странице обязательная реклама в шапке, всплывает снизу, и на страницах произвольно разбросано много рекламы и информативной рекламы сайта (которая тоже раньше блокировалась). Данный блокировщик подменяет встроенный блокировщик Яндекса (отключая его), что делает только хуже. Сейчас любой переход внутри одного сайта приводит к описанному выше. На некоторых сайтах реклама заполняет 120% экрана, приходится выискивать островки контента. > Всё скачено из официального Плей Маркета. Обновления через ВПН не помогают. Россия ### Screenshots

issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: AdGuard Persian Filter
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Problem description

According to the W3C ([https://w3techs.com/technologies/overview/content_language](https://w3techs.com/technologies/overview/content_language)), the amount of content on the internet is 1.0% Persian. This is more than languages such as Korean and Ukrainian. Unfortunately, PersianBlocker ([https://github.com/MasterKia/PersianBlocker](https://github.com/MasterKia/PersianBlocker)) is not being maintained anymore due to unforeseen causes.

### Proposed solution

Create an AdGuard Persian Filter by combining PersianBlocker (remove Pashto and Tajik entries?) and Persian entries from foreign.txt in the Base Filter.

### Additional information

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

### Affected site:
`https://www.vg.no/`

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])

@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [X] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [X] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;

### What product do you use?

Other ad blocker

### AdGuard version

uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

other (specify in comment below)

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://tv.vg.no/ (probably geo restricted)

https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

AdGuard Cookie Notices filter

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

### Affected site:
`https://www.vg.no/`

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .message-row > button[title="Avvis alle"], , 2000)
@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

--

### System info:
* OS/version: Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (x64)
* Browser/version: LibreWolf v121.0-1 (x64) [Tracking Protection = Standard]
* Adblock Extension/version: uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### Privacy

- [X] I agree to follow this condition

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://podcastor.fr/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpodcastor.fr%2F)

### Comment
> podcastor.fr is blocked by the AdGuard DNS Family protection server and is categorized as "Adult" (reports.adguard.com/fr/podcastor.fr/report.html). This is no longer correct.
> 
> podcastor.fr is the online shop of Podcastor, a French company that designs and sells audio story boxes for children (no screen, no subscription). The site only has product pages, information pages for parents and pages for our partner publishers (subdomains such as biblus.podcastor.fr or babayaga.podcastor.fr). There is no adult content.
> 
> Until mid-2024 the domain was used by an unrelated adult website. That content is gone and its old addresses return 404. The current registration dates from 24 July 2024 (see the .fr registry).
> 
> Our customers are parents, so the block stops the very families who use Family protection from reaching us. Could you please remove podcastor.fr and its subdomains from the adult category?
> 
> Thanks! Gabriel Macé, CEO of Podcastor
> Contact: `bonjour@podcastor.fr`



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/18bfdoigd0m8cswcwkws8gk8ck4swcst5336y0r15w.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/myhfidzrz6s408s8co4wg8kk044sc40njb2gpv6ssg.png?nc=1)
</details>

### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS
DNS setup: | Router
DNS server: | Family protection

Browser: | Chrome

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [X] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [X] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;

### What product do you use?

Other ad blocker

### AdGuard version

uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

other (specify in comment below)

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://tv.vg.no/ (probably geo restricted)

https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

AdGuard Cookie Notices filter

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

### Affected site:
`https://www.vg.no/`

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .message-row > button[title="Avvis alle"], , 2000)
@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

--

### System info:
* OS/version: Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (x64)
* Browser/version: LibreWolf v121.0-1 (x64) [Tracking Protection = Standard]
* Adblock Extension/version: uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### Privacy

- [X] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body:
> how can more permissive cookies break things

They won't..
I was simply asking you to confirm that those cookie values actually exist, after applying the AdGuard rules.
Just to make sure.
They don't HAVE to be set to `0`, although it would be preferable, of course. :)

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [X] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [X] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [X] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [X] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

Other ad blocker

### AdGuard version

uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

other (specify in comment below)

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://tv.vg.no/ (probably geo restricted)

https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

AdGuard Cookie Notices filter

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

### Affected site:
`https://www.vg.no/`

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .message-row > button[title="Avvis alle"], , 2000)
@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

--

### System info:
* OS/version: Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (x64)
* Browser/version: LibreWolf v121.0-1 (x64) [Tracking Protection = Standard]
* Adblock Extension/version: uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### Privacy

- [X] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body: Well, at least '**AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**' doesn't conflict with '**uBlock filters - Cookie Notices**' now (after removing `tek.no` from `##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`) ..but FYI; the scriptlet rules that you updated are completely useless, since they're targeting Schibsted's old cookie consent, which isn't used anymore. Like I mentioned in my previous post; Schibsted changed their scheme four months ago, so that it now requires an account in order to reject third-party tracking. **stephenhawk8054** were able to come up with some rather elaborate rules for '**uBlock filters - Cookie Notices**' though, which bypasses that requirement, and rejects the tracking!

The JavaScript filter added here has the added benefit of making filters for disabling automatic captions and super resolution work when loading videos via a direct URL instead of clicking a video link.

```
! Automatic chapters
www.youtube.com##+js(json-edit, $..[?@.playerBar.multiMarkersPlayerBarRenderer.visibleOnLoad.key=="AUTO_CHAPTERS"])
www.youtube.com##+js(json-edit, $..[?@.panelIdentifier=="engagement-panel-macro-markers-auto-chapters"])
www.youtube.com##+js(json-edit, $..[?@.horizontalCardListRenderer.header.richListHeaderRenderer.navigationButton.buttonRenderer.command.commandExecutorCommand.commands[0].updateEngagementPanelContentCommand.contentSourcePanelIdentifier.tag=="engagement-panel-macro-markers-auto-chapters"])
! Super Resolution quality options
www.youtube.com##+js(json-edit, $[?..paygatedQualitiesMetadata.qualityDetails[?.key=="1080p"]]..adaptiveFormats[?.qualityLabel=="1080p"])
www.youtube.com##+js(json-edit, $[?..paygatedQualitiesMetadata.qualityDetails[?.key=="720p"]]..adaptiveFormats[?.qualityLabel=="720p"])
```

Если полностью отключить AdGuard, страницы экскурсий сразу начинают загружаться нормально. После повторного включения AdGuard проблема возвращается. > > Пример страницы: > https://isratrip.net/excursions/sever-v-predvere-novogo-goda-37/ > > Устройство: iPhone 18 Pro Max > iOS: 27.0.1 > > Используется системный DNS (DNS-серверы интернет-провайдера). > > DNS-фильтр: > https://filters.adtidy.org/dns/filter_1_ios.txt > > Пожалуйста, проверьте, какое правило или фильтр AdGuard вызывает это ложное срабатывание, и исправьте его, чтобы сайт работал без необходимости полностью отключать AdGuard. ### Screenshots
